## Highlights

### 🛡️ No more libraries with known vulnerabilities
The AppImage no longer ships NuGet packages with published security advisories. The most serious was
`Tmds.DBus.Protocol` (high severity), which the app uses to talk to the Linux desktop over D-Bus: NMA now uses the
fixed version. OpenTelemetry is updated too (telemetry stays disabled), and the build no longer pulls a vulnerable
Source Link package.

### 🐛 Cyberpunk 2077 REDmod load order
The app could crash while closing if it was still updating the REDmod load order of a Cyberpunk 2077 loadout: the
update went on reading the database after it was closed. Closing now waits for the update to finish. These updates
also run in the background instead of on the interface's thread.

### 📖 New README
The project page now says what the fork adds over the original app, which games and Linux launchers it supports,
and how it is made.

## Full changelog

- `fix(deps)` update or replace the NuGet packages with known vulnerabilities: Tmds.DBus.Protocol, OpenTelemetry,
  Source Link, Magick.NET (tests)
- `fix(sort-order)` wait for the running updates when disposing the sort order manager
- `docs` rewrite the README

## Install

Download `NMAcommunity.App.x86_64.AppImage` below, `chmod +x`, run.
